# Aurarium

[![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/arcane-wizard-dev/Aurarium?color=blue&logo=github&cacheSeconds=600)](https://github.com/arcane-wizard-dev/Aurarium/releases) [![GitHub Release Date](https://img.shields.io/github/release-date/arcane-wizard-dev/Aurarium?color=blue&logo=github&cacheSeconds=600)](https://github.com/arcane-wizard-dev/Aurarium/releases)

_Gold and currencies, always in view._

Aurarium is a World of Warcraft addon that tracks gold and currencies across characters. It brings recorded balances together in clear overviews and makes changes over time easy to follow.

> ⚠️ **Important!** This addon requires **Arcane Wizard: Library**. See Installation & Quick Start for installation details.

## Key Features

**Gold Display** - Shows the current gold balance in a customizable display that fits into the game interface.

**Gold and Currency Overview** - Browse recorded balances by character, faction, or account total.

**Chart** - Explore your balance history in a chart and choose the period you want to examine.

## Features

Individual features and display options can be configured in the addon settings. Aurarium supports an account profile and character profiles.

### Gold Display

* Shows or hides the compact gold display independently of balance tracking.
* Lets you choose which coins appear in the gold display.

### Gold and Currency Overview

* Shows gold and currency balances by day and month.\*
* Saves and shows balances individually for each character.
* Shows character and Warband currencies separately.\*\*
* Shows totals for the selected currency across all recorded characters.
* Can hide days without balance changes.
* Tracks daily WoW Token prices for the current region.\*\*

### Chart

* Shows a line chart for a character, Alliance, Horde, the account total, the Warband\*\*, or WoW Token prices\*\*.
* Offers preset periods or a custom date range.

*\* In Classic only gold is tracked.*

*\*\* This feature is only available in Retail.*

## Supported Languages & Flavors

* Languages: English, German, Russian
* Flavors: Classic, Burning Crusade - Classic Anniversary Edition, Mists of Pandaria - Classic, Forever, Retail

## Installation & Quick Start

> **Required Dependency:** This addon requires **Arcane Wizard: Library**. If you install Aurarium via the CurseForge client, the library will be downloaded automatically. If you install the addon manually, via Wago, or through another third-party updater that does not resolve dependencies, you must download and enable the library separately.

To manage the addon, type the following commands in chat and press Enter:

* Type `/aur` or `/aurarium` to access the addon options menu.
* Type `/aur help` or `/aurarium help` to see the available chat commands and answers to frequently asked questions.
* Type `/aur changelog` or `/aurarium changelog` to open the changelog.
* Type `/aur overview` or `/aurarium overview` to manually display the Gold and Currency Overview.
* Type `/aur chart` or `/aurarium chart` to manually display the Chart.

## Bugs & Feedback

If you find a bug or have a suggestion, please open a GitHub issue or leave a comment on CurseForge.

## Translation Support

If you would like to localize this addon into other languages, your contribution would be very welcome. Please submit your translations directly via GitHub.

[Full Changelog](https://github.com/arcane-wizard-dev/Aurarium/compare/v2.48...v2.49) - [Previous Releases](https://github.com/arcane-wizard-dev/Aurarium/releases)

**Important note: Migration of older character data will be removed at the end of 2026. Log in once with each character using an up-to-date version of Aurarium before then to preserve their gold and currency history.**

- Added: A help command lists available slash commands, and unknown commands show a hint in chat
- Added: Alliance and Horde balance views in the overview and chart
- Added: Optional markers for the highest and lowest chart values
- Changed: The Gold & Currencies tab uses one menu to select a character, a faction, or the total
- Changed: Character names now include first and last names [forever]
- Changed: The chart's Category dropdown is disabled when Gold & Currencies is the only option [forever]
- Requires Arcane Wizard: Library revision 6 or later
